description: This file defines a GatewayDiscoveryModel class responsible for discovering and managing network gateways using Bonjour DNS-SD, Tailscale, and wide-area discovery methods. It includes data structures for representing local identities and discovered gateways, methods for starting/stopping discovery, resolving services, and handling network results.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: Main class for discovering and managing network gateways, supporting Bonjour, wide-area, and Tailscale discovery methods.

classes.name: ResolvedGatewayService
classes.description: Represents a resolved network service with TXT records, host, and port information.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: Handles asynchronous DNS service resolution using NetService, with delegate callbacks for success or failure.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins network gateway discovery by creating DNS browsers for configured domains.

methods.name: refreshWideAreaFallbackNow
methods.description: Performs immediate wide-area gateway discovery with a specified timeout.

methods.name: refreshTailscaleServeFallbackNow
methods.description: Performs immediate Tailscale gateway discovery with a specified timeout.

methods.name: refreshRemoteFallbackNow
methods.description: Triggers both wide-area and Tailscale fallback discoveries.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing discovery processes and clears internal state.

methods.name: mapWideAreaBeacons
methods.description: Converts wide-area beacon data into DiscoveredGateway objects.

methods.name: mapTailscaleServeBeacons
methods.description: Converts Tailscale beacon data into DiscoveredGateway objects.

methods.name: recomputeGateways
methods.description: Recomputes the list of gateways based on current results and fallbacks.

methods.name: updateGateways
methods.description: Updates gateways list for a specific domain based on DNS results.

methods.name: scheduleWideAreaFallback
methods.description: Schedules background task for wide-area fallback discovery with retries.

methods.name: scheduleTailscaleServeFallback
methods.description: Schedules background task for Tailscale fallback discovery with retries.

methods.name: shouldContinueTailscaleServeDiscovery
methods.description: Determines whether to continue Tailscale discovery based on current results.

methods.name: hasUsableWideAreaResults
methods.description: Checks if there are valid wide-area discovery results available.

methods.name: dedupeKey
methods.description: Generates a deduplication key for gateways based on endpoint or stable ID.

methods.name: sortedDeduped
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of gateways with duplicates removed.

methods.name: buildLocalIdentityFast
methods.description: Builds a quick local identity based on hostname and display name.

methods.name: buildLocalIdentitySlow
methods.description: Builds a comprehensive local identity including current host info.

methods.name: isLocalGateway
methods.description: Determines if a gateway is local based on host and display tokens.

methods.name: ensureServiceResolution
methods.description: Initiates DNS service resolution if not already resolved or pending.

methods.name: decodeTXT
methods.description: Decodes TXT record data into a dictionary of strings.

methods.name: parseGatewayTXT
methods.description: Parses a dictionary of TXT record strings into GatewayTXT structure.

methods.name: buildSSHTarget
methods.description: Constructs an SSH target string from user, host, and port.
